# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated directory of 1406 AI agent tools for builders and ready-to-use products. Facts are verified; pricing is as makers state it.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com

## Machine-readable catalog

- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): full catalog
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)

- [ReimagineHome](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/reimaginehome.html) (added 2026-10-18): AI interior and exterior redesign and virtual staging from room photos.
- [Fotello](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/fotello.html) (added 2026-10-18): AI real-estate photo editing and delivery: HDR, twilights and virtual staging.
- [Secta Labs](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/secta-labs.html) (added 2026-10-18): AI headshot service that makes professional portraits from your own photos.
- [Peakto](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/peakto.html) (added 2026-10-18): AI media organizer for Mac that catalogs photos across Lightroom, Capture One and Apple Photos.
- [Mylio Photos](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/mylio-photos.html) (added 2026-10-18): Private photo library across your devices with on-device AI tagging and face recognition.
- [PhotoPrism](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/photoprism.html) (added 2026-10-18): Self-hosted AI photo library that auto-tags, recognizes faces and finds places.
- [Immich](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/immich.html) (added 2026-10-18): Self-hosted photo and video library with AI face recognition and smart search, a private alternative to Google Photos.
- [WeShop AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/weshop-ai.html) (added 2026-10-18): AI fashion and product photos: virtual models, try-on and backgrounds for e-commerce.
- [Mokker](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/mokker.html) (added 2026-10-18): Replaces product photo backgrounds with realistic studio scenes.
- [Virtual Staging AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/virtual-staging-ai.html) (added 2026-10-18): Virtually stages empty rooms in real-estate photos with furniture in seconds.
- [PicWish](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/picwish.html) (added 2026-10-18): Background remover, photo enhancer and AI editing tools for web and mobile, with an API.
- [PortraitPro](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/portraitpro.html) (added 2026-10-18): Desktop portrait retouching software that uses AI face mapping for skin and lighting.
